text: Here is the flow. An agent proposes a purchase, a policy engine decides, and PayPal only places a hold until a person captures it.
AI agents that buy things need limits the model cannot argue with. Allowance gives each agent a mandate: a cap per purchase, an amount it may spend alone, and a daily budget.
I give the gift finder an errand. It searches real products through Channel3, and a Fireworks model picks one. Policy approves this small purchase, and PayPal places a sandbox authorization hold.
Larger purchases wait here for a person. Anything over the cap is denied before PayPal is called, like this twenty seven thousand dollar watch. I approve the held blanket and capture the socks.
The dashboard is an AG Studio report over the same data: spend, limits, and an audit trail.
A treasurer agent inside Studio manages mandates. I ask it to pause the office agent, and it does. Raising a limit needs a person to confirm.
Without the policy engine, the same agent authorized over twenty seven thousand dollars. With it, under sixty.
Funding here is a PayPal sandbox test card. The wallet approval path is implemented but not exercised.
